_note: Every figure carries a source key and was checked against the official page on the date in `sources`. Fees are MOH private-clinic benchmarks, before GST, unless the procedure says otherwise. Anything not in an official table is left out rather than guessed.

consult.name: Consultation
consult.plain: The dentist checks your teeth and gums and plans any treatment

xray.name: X-ray (small)
xray.plain: A close-up X-ray to see between and inside teeth

scale_polish.name: Scaling and polishing
scale_polish.plain: A professional cleaning that removes tartar and surface stains

filling_simple.name: Simple filling
filling_simple.plain: Removes a small area of decay and fills the hole

filling_complex.name: Complex filling
filling_complex.plain: A larger filling covering more of the tooth

rct_molar.name: Root canal treatment (back tooth)
rct_molar.plain: Cleans out an infected or inflamed nerve inside the tooth

crown.name: Permanent crown
crown.plain: A cap that covers and protects a weakened tooth

denture_partial_simple.name: Partial denture (fewer than 6 teeth, one jaw)
denture_partial_simple.plain: A removable plate that fills gaps from missing teeth

implant_crown.name: Implant with crown (one tooth, public hospital)
implant_crown.plain: A fixed artificial tooth anchored in the jaw
implant_crown.range_note: Lowest to highest 2025 hospital average. Bone grafts and scans are extra.

later.label: If the decay is larger (instead of a simple filling)
If it has reached the nerve (on top of the visit)

tooth_discoloration.note: Whitening is cosmetic. It isn't covered by CHAS and has no MOH benchmark, so it isn't estimated here.

later.label: If you choose a partial denture
If it lasts more than 2 weeks

mouth_ulcer.note: Most mouth ulcers heal by themselves within 1 to 2 weeks, so there is often nothing to pay.

normal.note: A routine check-up and cleaning every 6 to 12 months.

claim_limits.consultation: Up to 2 a year, 6 months apart
claim_limits.rct_molar: Up to 2 root canals a year

flexi_medisave.note: Flexi-MediSave is your own MediSave savings, not a subsidy: up to S$400 a year in total towards root canals and crowns, at CHAS dental clinics and public hospitals.

general_notes: Typical ranges from MOH fee benchmarks for private clinics. Actual fees vary by clinic and case.
The higher figure includes 9% GST. GST-registered CHAS clinics add GST before taking off the CHAS subsidy.
CHAS subsidies only apply at CHAS dental clinics. Polyclinics and public hospitals have their own subsidised rates.
